collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_kvs_emb_nc32a --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_kvs_emb --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_embedding_row_tx/views/qkd_embedding_row_tx > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
